      "reproduction": "In tests/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.test.mjs add: `const swapped = structuredClone(corpus); swapped.cases[7].sourceText = \"표로 정리해줘. 추가 문장.\"; delete swapped.contentDigest; swapped.contentDigest = promptRefinerShadowCorpusDigest(structuredClone(swapped));` (the same re-sign helper used at tests/promptRefinerShadowHarness.test.mjs:74-79, importing promptRefinerShadowCorpusDigest from ../lib/promptRefinerShadowHarness.ts), then `const bundle = evaluatePromptRefinerShadowEvidence({ corpus: swapped, spec, cases: passingRunCases() });`. The existing tamper test only covers an unsigned mutation, so it does not catch this."

Observed: gateOutcome === \"insufficient_evidence\" while gateReasons contains \"terminal_failure_present\" and \"case_evidence_failed\". Expected: \"fail\", since a conclusive threshold miss is present regardless of the missing cost row."
